title: "VTPEH 6105: Biostatistics for Health Sciences"

Welcome to VTPEH 6105. Use the sidebar to access the combined syllabus and schedule, or jump directly to a workshop.

## Course Description

- Introduce core biostatistics concepts
- Learn R for data analysis
- Apply methods to real public health datasets

## Regular Weekly Schedule

| Item       | Details                                                                                       |
|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Lectures   | Fridays, 11:15 AM – 1:45 PM (one 2h30 session)                                                |
| Term       | Spring Semester                                                                               |
| Workload   | 14 weeks of in-class lecture and practice (2h30/week); homework approximately 5 hours/week    |
| Location   | LH3 (S2-223) or LH4 (S1-210), as indicated on Canvas                                          |
